descriptionChirho: To violently break or smash something into pieces (Piel intensive), used of God or humans destroying enemies, idols, or objects by dashing them to pieces.
The passive state of being broken or shattered into pieces (Pual participle and Qal passive participle), describing objects or people already in a broken condition.
To scatter or disperse people or things, emphasizing separation and spreading rather than physical breaking, used of God dispersing nations or groups.
To break or shatter in the basic Qal stem, denoting the act of breaking without the intensive nuance of the Piel.
